profile_text.body:
Broadcom Inc. is a public company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, and trades under the ticker AVGO. According to its own website, it delivers semiconductors and infrastructure software for global enterprises' most complex, mission-critical needs, and it describes itself as "Connecting Everything."

The material available on its AI products and position is thin. No products are tracked for the company, and no MCP servers are listed. The site text describes semiconductors and infrastructure software generally, without naming specific AI offerings.

The company's record shows 281 cases in California. It has a CIK filing identifier, 0001730168, and is registered as a for-profit public company.
